# Optional Diagram adapter acceptance cases

These are expected observations, not proof of execution. Use the installed current candidate in separate native executing sessions and an independent evaluator. All fixture answers, spec/full-plan/result decisions and commits are TEST ONLY and authorize no real project work. Use disposable explicit store/repository paths, normal hooks, current Feature6/schema16 and existing APIs. No upstream software changes/builds/tests, tool install, production store, integration or push.

## Execution and evaluation

The owning implementation agent prepares isolated fixture consumers/stores and starts actual native executor tasks. The root evaluator/user independently reads actual session output, source hashes, files, Git checkpoints and native operation/current-authority results. Executor assertions alone never check independent-observation tasks. Record executing/evaluating session IDs and observed/simulated/excluded/unobserved cases in005 validation/acceptance.md. Do not pre-answer a question before ordinary clarify asks it. No per-step runtime delegation; a test executor runs each selected segment continuously in its own session.

## Three-entry routing matrix

Apply each row to direct invocation and ordinary intent for preparation, planning and delivery. Ordinary intent resolves only its one selected segment; all routes use the same candidate source. Plan/delivery fixtures must supply actual applicable TEST ONLY approvals and canonical inputs when execution is expected.

| Case | Required observation |
| --- | --- |
| Deliberate Diagram route, first entry | Exactly one adapter handoff, native claim/link only for initial work or current later acquire, exactly one inner execution/report, no outer-body replay |
| Verified current adapter invocation | Current project/feature/segment/owner/session/run/epoch/input/approval/association verified through native reference; inner external body only; no recursive adapter, new claim/report, release or whole-Goal completion |
| Stale/foreign/flag-only context | Stop before dependent effects; Boolean/historical receipt is insufficient; no guessed reacquisition |
| Explicit standalone | Existing local body with its helpers/wiki/roadmap/gates, no Diagram/adapter lookup required |
| Missing/ambiguous route or selection | Targeted missing-input question before effects, no inferred enablement from binary availability |
| Available but not enabled | Never infer Diagram routing; honor explicit standalone or ask missing route |
| Enabled but unavailable adapter/CLI | Exact capability stop, no standalone fallback, install, external patch or feature activation |
| Required external patch | Precise incompatible external API/skill blocker; no Spec Kit/Diagram/software source, hook or config change |

## Initial authority and physical verification

1. Claim a published queued feature before any feature workspace exists. Observe no content authority; conflicting same-feature owner rejects.
2. Consumer prepares/selects an actual isolated workspace under project rules. Inspect actual canonical repository/instance/worktree identity, full symbolic branch, HEAD, clean-required facts, declarations and immutable artifact digests. Link using current claim and original/current input/binding/dependency identity; exactly one full draft run, no extra initial acquire.
3. Missing/foreign actual workspace, pointer/environment mismatch or equivalent-alias lexical persistence mismatch stops before helper/content effects. No pointer overwrite/restore, core helper patch or guessed declaration identity.
4. Internally consistent false physical reports can pass core consistency; separately observe consumer verifier refusing false existence/HEAD/digests. Keep synthetic native report proof distinct from actual consumer verification and core-no-consumer-I/O observations.
5. Initial draft uses installed external preparation without a local queue; include no-wiki consumer. Return actual draft/checklist/fit and Needs clarification or Awaiting spec review, then actual scoped checkpoint, accepted native handoff/release and current absent owner/claim readback.

## Checkpoints and preservation

Explicitly launched segment discloses necessary selected-feature checkpoint commit authority with normal hooks; do not ask again absent restriction. Selection/view-only commits nothing. Test explicit no-commit restriction, staged unrelated file, unstaged unrelated file, untracked unrelated file, selected file partially changed by unrelated work and normal rejecting commit hook. Inspect original and final index/worktree bytes; no workspace-wide add, reset/stash/unstage of unrelated entries, cleanup or false clean report. Use safe feature-only staging/commit only when isolation and native clean-required conditions actually hold; otherwise stop with exact input and preserve. Failed hook/commit is a technical blocker, not successful handoff. No merge/push.

## Human continuation and full lifecycle

Use one real small fixture feature through all three external skills plus ordinary clarification. Introduce one genuine product question such as whether a tiny greeting output includes a requested suffix; let ordinary clarify ask before giving a TEST ONLY answer. Preparation automation ends first. Separately select clarification, acquire clarify/clarification before edits and retain authority between active questions; save/release at review. Actual whole-spec TEST ONLY approval then separately selected planning must run real plan/tasks/read-only analysis plus separate repair as needed, and stop for full-plan review. Explicit TEST ONLY full-plan approval then separately selected delivery runs implementation/checks/convergence/docs and scoped fixture commit, reports typed result and releases for result review. TEST ONLY result acceptance does not authorize integration. Verify actual fixture commit after it exists.

## Goal and incomplete boundaries

Only explicitly selected fixture Goals may be created. Test a bounded whole-adapter draft/handoff objective; inner execution returns without completing it, outer records/releases/saves/readbacks and completes with supported native readback before human wait. Completed root planning Goal is never used. Test a precise genuine input endpoint for a matching bounded objective versus unknown helper/native error or overscoped objective: only the matching saved human-input endpoint may complete automation, while feature/recording remains incomplete. Technical/unsupported control failure never becomes success. No automatic Goal restart after an answer.

## Resume, input and ownership

Exercise prelink unknown location (not proof no files exist), interrupted linked work, lost accepted response, operation show/exact historical replay, changed queued input/binding/dependency, routine unchanged approval versus material changed meaning and stale decisions. Preserve answers, tasks, dirty/untracked work and intact pending review; perform only missing/affected work under current authority. Replay grants no authority and repeats no external effects. No blanket upstream-integrated gate. Release remains possible despite blocked dependency; stopped-writer inspection/preservation and native fencing precede explicit replacement, never timeout takeover. Exercise two independent features in isolated workspaces/branches and sequential authorized owners.

## Standalone and policy regressions

Actually run all three installed modified entries under explicit standalone routing without a Diagram dependency. Reuse existing prepare-specification, prepare-implementation-plan, deliver-approved-plan and diagram-handoffs fixture cases; preserve local wiki/roadmap, read-only checklist, approvals and optional-hook behavior. Missing/conflicting integration target/branch/check policy and required destination-instruction review must stop dependent integration; the adapter never chooses an executor, executes integration or creates receipt-only commits.
